description: Finds notes in Apple Notes whose title or text contains the query, newest first, with each note's id for notes_read. With no query and no folder, lists the folders (with note counts) and the most recently changed notes.

limit.description: At most this many notes (default 20, up to 100)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

name: notes_find
title: Find Notes
